baseline_pooling: attention-masked mean over tokens, raw text without chat template, max_length 512, batch 32 sorted by length
binarisation: top 5% of units by absolute pooled activation per sample and layer
signature_criterion: one-sided two-proportion z-test; BH-FDR q < 0.05 within each (layer, emotion) family of 8,960 tests; Cohen's h >= 0.2; p_target > p_other
prompting: chat template, single user turn, instruction before stimulus, assistant prefix 'Answer:' for forced choice
scorers: NRC Emotion Lexicon as bundled in nrclex 4.1.0

internal_measures.preregistered: mean signed z over signature units (failed held-out validity)
internal_measures.mask (principal, Deviation 1): fraction of signature units in the top 5% of the pooled activation
internal_measures.absz (robustness, Deviation 1): mean standardised absolute activation over signature units

statistics: LMM with crossed random intercepts (item, paraphrase), REML (lmm_crossed.py, validated against statsmodels); logistic GLMM by variational Bayes; Holm across 14 hypotheses
